body.p: The following remarks are made in response to the Action. In this Response, claims 1, 4, and 10 have been amended. No claims have been canceled. No claims have been newly added. Claims 1-4, 6, and 8-10 are pending. The claim amendments are supported by at least, for example, paragraphs [0037] and [0063] of the Specification as filed. There is no new matter.
Claims 1-4, 6, and 8-10 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. §102(a)(1) as being anticipated by CN 208645329 ("Pei"). Applicant traverses the rejection.

Without agreeing to the propriety of the rejection, and to expedite prosecution, claim 1 has been amended to further recite, in part, "a first arm link; a hollow shaft extending along a first axis thereof and coupled to the first arm link, wherein the hollow shaft allows for cables to pass therethrough; and a second arm link connected to the hollow shaft." The Action states that Pei discloses the "first arm link (48); a hollow shaft (43,44) extending along a first axis ... and coupled to the first arm link." (Action at p. 2.) For at least the below reasons, Pei does not disclose the above recited features of amended claim 1.

Pei discloses a "four-joint structure ... comprising a suspension bracket 10, first arm 20, second arm 30." (Pei at p. 3 of machine translation.) Pei also discloses a "second cantilever 30 of the hand drive device comprises a lifting mechanism 30 and a rotating mechanism 40." (Pei at p. 3 of machine translation.) In Pei, the "rotating mechanism 40 [includes] a rotating motor [41], a planetary gear reducer 42, the third toothed belt transmission device, a spline shaft 43, and spline 44." (Pei at p. 3 of machine translation.) Moreover, Pei discloses the "spline shaft 43 is a hollow shaft, the top is provided with a rotary air joint 48." (Pei at p. 3 of machine translation.) The "rotary air joint 48" in Pei does not disclose the "first arm link," as recited in amended claim 1. In Pei, and as shown in FIG. 2, the "second arm 30" includes the "rotating mechanism 40." Moreover, in Pei, and as shown in FIG. 8, the "rotating mechanism 40" discloses including the "spline shaft 43," the "spline 44," and the "rotary air joint 48" arranged on top of the "spline shaft 43." Therefore, the "rotary air joint 48" in Pei is part of the "rotating mechanism 40" located in
the "second arm 30." Pei does not disclose the "rotary arm joint 48" being the "first arm link," as recited in amended claim 1.

For similar reasons as above, the "spline shaft 43" in Pei does not disclose "extending along a first axis thereof and coupled to the first arm link," as recited in amended claim 1. Although the "spline shaft 43" in Pei discloses being coupled to the "rotary air joint 48," the "rotary air joint 48" in Pei does not disclose the "first arm link" as recited in amended claim 1. Instead, Pei discloses the "first cantilever 20 of the rear end 28 is fixed on the hollow output shaft," and the "second cantilever 30 of the back end 38 of the first cantilever 20 front end, a hollow input shaft of the cycloidal pinwheel speed reducer 22." (Pei at p. 3 of machine translation.) Therefore, Pei does not disclose the "first arm link," and the "hollow shaft extending along a first axis thereof and coupled to the first arm link," as recited in amended claim 1.

Moreover, in Pei, the "spline shaft 43" and "spline 44" does not disclose "allow[ing] for cables to pass therethrough," as recited in amended claim 1. Although Pei discloses the "spline shaft 43" is a "hollow shaft," the "spline shaft 43" in Pei does not disclose "allow[ing] for cables to pass therethrough," as recited in amended claim 1. Instead, the "spline shaft 43" in Pei enables air to pass to the "rotary air joint 48." Pei is silent on the "spline shaft 43" allowing cables to pass therethrough. Therefore, the "spline shaft 43" and "spline 44" in Pei does not disclose "a hollow shaft extending along a first axis thereof and coupled to the first arm link, wherein the hollow shaft allows for cables to pass therethrough; and a second arm link coupled to the hollow shaft," as recited in amended claim 1.

For similar reasons as above, the "rotary air joint 48" in Pei also does not disclose the "second arm link connected to the hollow shaft," as recited in amended claim 1. Thus, Pei does not disclose "a first arm link; a hollow shaft extending along a first axis thereof and coupled to the first arm link, wherein the hollow shaft allows for cables to pass therethrough; and a second arm link connected to the hollow shaft," as recited in amended claim 1.
For at least the above reasons, independent claim 1 and its dependent claims 2- 4, 6, and 8-10 are not anticipated by Pei. Applicant does not concede the correctness of
the rejection with respect to features not discussed herein. Applicant requests favorable reconsideration of the claims and withdrawal of the rejection.
Claims 1-4, 6, and 8-10 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Pei. Applicant traverses the rejections.

For similar reasons as above, independent claim 1 and its dependent claims 2-4, 6, and 8-10 are patentable over Pei. Applicant does not concede the correctness of the rejection with respect to features not discussed herein. Applicant requests favorable reconsideration of the claims and withdrawal of the rejection.

It is submitted that the rejections in the Action have been successfully traversed and that the application is now in condition for allowance. Reconsideration of the application and allowance thereof is solicited.

It is believed that all the pending claims have been addressed. However, the absence of a reply to a specific allegation or comment of the Action does not signify agreement or concession with that part. Also, the arguments herein are not exhaustive. The amendment or cancelation of a claim or other part of the Specification does not necessarily signify concession with an allegation or comment of the Action. Applicant reserves the right to prosecute the rejected claims in further prosecution of this or related applications.
Authorization is hereby provided to charge any fees which may be required for the present filing, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 501561.
